title: Freelancer (MISC, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Freelancer is a long-range medium freighter from MISC, a maker of freighters, miners and transports in Star Citizen. Pilot and co-pilot sit in a raised cockpit above the cargo hold. The pilot uses the common controls.

panels.name: Freelancer: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Freelancer's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Cargo (66 SCU)
controls.text: The Freelancer's hold takes 66 SCU of cargo. The goods travel in standard boxes.
controls.context: Cargo is counted in SCU (standard cargo units, boxes of one fixed size). Traders fill the hold at stations and outposts.

areas.name: Crew stations
areas.text: The other seats and stations of the ship besides the pilot's.

panels.name: Freelancer: crew stations
panels.text: These are the seats and stations of the Freelancer besides the pilot's seat.
panels.context: Each crew member sits at a station of their own; the pilot flies while the others work turrets or other equipment.

controls.name: Crew (up to four)
controls.text: Up to four people can fly together in the Freelancer. The catalog has not checked its weapons.
controls.context: Extra crew can help with the jobs on board while the pilot flies.
